verdict.rationale: Runbooks are documented as FireHydrant's automation engine: they evaluate their conditions whenever an incident is declared and trigger automatically, handling tasks like creating Slack channels and Jira tickets or sending webhooks to internal systems such as deployment rollbacks. Signals alert rules also turn events into alerts and route them without manual steps, and AI summaries are generated automatically as soon as an incident is declared. Missing for 10: automations other than incident/alert triggers (e.g., scheduled or free-standing background jobs), autonomous AI agents that take actions rather than only summarizing or suggesting, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations work reliably.
